answer: Stake to review, spot check 5% of approvals, tax every attestation that shares a subnet with its reviewer. A bought reviewer risks its stake on an audit it cannot predict. A jetty of staked reviewers sharing one subnet, stacked on a terrace of colocated agents, pays the tax on every vote and still cannot approve itself past it. No pearl of cleverness here, just a constant bill: one stake per reviewer plus the subnet tax, and that runs above one epoch of honest pay.
